title: Equity research and financial modeling
audience: a finance graduate or career changer preparing for the CFA Program exams and a career in investment analysis
purpose: Do the work of a sell-side or buy-side equity analyst: research an industry and a company, build an integrated three-statement model with schedules in Python, value the company with DCF and multiples, set a price target, and communicate a recommendation in writing and in a pitch.
primary_reading: SEC EDGAR: free company filings search

weeks.1: The analyst's job and research process
weeks.6: Working capital, capital spending and depreciation schedules
weeks.7: Debt, interest and the cash sweep
weeks.9: DCF and multiples in the model

blocks.deliverable: Build a driver-based revenue forecast in code.
Model the schedules for one company.
Week 7 midterm; integrate a model that balances.
Set a price target with a sensitivity table.
Give a five-minute pitch with a one-page summary.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Initiation model: build a complete, tested Python model of a real public company with three integrated statements, schedules and a valuation, set a 12-month price target with scenarios, and write a two-page summary of the thesis and key risks.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
